items.stem: A programme is best defined as:

options.text: A group of related projects managed together to achieve benefits not available individually
options.rationale: Correct: programmes coordinate related projects for collective benefit.

options.text: Any project that costs a lot of money
options.rationale: Cost does not make a project a programme.

options.text: A single large project with many tasks
options.rationale: Size alone does not make a programme.

options.text: The company's entire set of initiatives

items.explanation: Correct: programmes coordinate related projects for collective benefit.
